text:
maya: Posting the postmortem follow-up for the missing spans + bad aggregation incident. I pulled action items into a single table in the doc: https://docs.internal/postmortems/1769801234. Please ack and own items where assigned.

harry: Ack. Quick question — do we know if it was sampling config or exporter backpressure that caused the missing spans? Logs point at exporter timeouts.

maya: Short summary from the postmortem: intermittent exporter timeouts caused span drops at the collector, and an agg job had a GROUP BY that dropped nulls leading to bad aggregation counts. Both combined made analytics look off.

li: I can own the ETL lag/backfill remediation for the "observability-aggregator" pipeline. Plan: add retry + exponential backoff on exporter writes, implement a lightweight backpressure queue, and trigger an ad-hoc backfill for the last 48h if we still see gaps. Change cron from */5 to */1 for backfills while we stabilize. ETA: 2 weeks. Will open PR tomorrow.

gabe: I'll take aggregation correctness (fix the GROUP BY/null handling and add defensive checks). Test plan: unit tests for null buckets, integration job that runs a synthetic trace load. ETA: 1 week. I'll post PR link.

sara-sre: We need an alert for span ingest drop — suggest: if span ingest rate < 70% of baseline for 5m raise P2, attach runbook to check exporter health and restart collector shards. I'll add SLO + runbook. Assigning to me.

anita-analytics: I'll add a daily analytics sanity check that compares aggregated span counts vs token/ingest counts and sends anomaly alerts to #incidents. Also adding a reconciliation job to detect gaps >1000 spans per 1h window.

deploy-bot: deploy notice: obs-collector v2.1.4 -> v2.1.5 deployed to staging at 2026-03-08T14:12Z.

maya: Action table snapshot:

```
action,owner,eta,status
backfill-fix,li,2026-03-22,open
agg-validations,gabe,2026-03-15,in-progress
slo-alert,sara-sre,2026-03-10,open
daily-compare,anita-analytics,2026-03-12,open
postmortem-follow-up,maya,2026-03-09,open
```

harry: Recurring pattern note: this is the 3rd similar incident in ~6 months (missing spans or bad counts). We should consider a deeper reliability review of the exporter and collector handshake.

sara-sre: :thumbsup: I'll schedule a quarterly exporter/collector reliability audit and a post-rollout smoke test.

li: Quick log excerpt I pulled: 
```
[2026-03-08T13:09:21Z] ERROR exporter: POST /v1/ingest -> 504 Gateway Timeout
task_id=xyz shard=5 latency_ms=12034
```

gabe: I'll add regression tests that simulate 504s and ensure the aggregator tolerates missing spans and flags anomalies rather than silently dropping.

maya: Please add PR links in the doc and update the action table status as you make progress. I'll run weekly check-ins on Fridays and maintain the table. @channel react with :white_check_mark: when you accept ownership.

harry: Accepted. :white_check_mark:

sara-sre: Accepted. :white_check_mark:

li: Accepted, will post PR by EOD tomorrow. :white_check_mark:

gabe: Accepted, will have tests and PR this week. :white_check_mark:

maya: Thanks everyone — capturing this thread into the PM doc and linking back to the incident timeline. We'll escalate to a reliability review if we see another occurrence within 90 days.
